suppress.notes: CVE-2025-7962: SMTP injection trong Jakarta Mail < 2.0.2 / Angus MAIL < 2.0.4. App chi co angus-ACTIVATION (JAF, keo theo boi jakarta.activation), khong dung Angus Mail.
CVE-2026-42154: DoS o endpoint /api/v1/read cua Prometheus SERVER (Go) < 3.5.3 / 3.11.3. micrometer-registry-prometheus la thu vien Java xuat metrics, khong phai Prometheus server.
CVE-2026-39883: PATH hijacking (lenh kenv tren BSD/Solaris) trong OpenTelemetry-GO 1.15.0-1.42.0. opentelemetry-semconv la jar Java chi chua hang so semantic conventions, khong goi lenh he thong.
